applicationProcess.process_md:
**Unregistered Applicant :** 1. All the applicant have to visit the official [website](https://cglabour.nic.in) Chhattisgarh Labour Department. 1. On the home page click on "[Apply](https://cglabour.nic.in/Departments.aspx?id=4)" under "Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers State Social Security Board".1. Enter the following details 1. Select Group Name : "Asangathit Marmakaar Mandal" 1. Select Service : "Asangathit Shramik Panjikaran" 1. What do you want to do : "Aavedan" 1. Click next. 1. Check the eligibility criteria for registration in Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers State Social Security Board and click next. 1. Fill out the online "Registration form". 1. Submit.

**Already Registered Applicant :** 1. All the applicant have to visit the official [website](https://cglabour.nic.in) Chhattisgarh Labour Department. 1. On the home page click on "[Apply](https://cglabour.nic.in/Departments.aspx?id=4)" under "Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers State Social Security Board".1. Enter the following details 1. Select Group Name : "Asangathit Marmakaar Mandal" 1. Select Service : "Yojana" 1. What do you want to do : "Aavedan" 1. Click next. 1. Select your district name and provide old/new registration number and click next. 1. Select the scheme name. 1. Fill out the online with required details. 1. Submit.

basicDetails.schemeName: Nai Hetu Avashyak Upkaran Sahayata Yojana

children.text: Applicant must be registered Unorganized worker of State Social Security Board.
Applicant age must be between 18 to 60 years.
Applicant must not receiving any other parallel scheme of the state government

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
1. Applicant must be registered Unorganized worker of State Social Security Board. 
1. Applicant age must be between 18 to 60 years. 
1. Applicant must not receiving any other parallel scheme of the state government

children.text: Registered barbers will be provided barber kit including scissors, straight razor, comb, hair cutting cape, water spray bottle and shaving brush.

schemeContent.benefits_md: > Registered barbers will be provided barber kit including scissors, straight razor, comb, hair cutting cape, water spray bottle and shaving brush.
schemeContent.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Nai Hetu Avashyak Upkaran Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 27 January 2018.

children.text: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Nai Hetu Avashyak Upkaran Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on  27 January 2018.. The main objective of the scheme to empower unorganized worker by providing required equipment for their work.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme &quot;Nai Hetu Avashyak Upkaran Sahayata Yojana&quot; for unorganized worker on  27 January 2018.. The main objective of the scheme to empower unorganized worker by providing required equipment for their work.
